data.job_title: Data Science Engineer Operational Analytics, Predictive Modelling & Reporting
data.additional_information:
Data Science Engineer
Operational Analytics, Predictive Modelling & Reporting
Location: Hyderabad / BBSR / Remote-Capable Type: Permanent · Full-Time
Compensation: FP1 to FP3 · ₹16 LPA to ₹45 LPA
CTC
Contact: Placement Cell
THE ROLE
Fluxion's data science function is operational, not academic. The models we build run in production environments where their
outputs influence decisions worth crore of rupees: sinter plant coke dosing, blast furnace thermal management, port berth
utilisation, and clinical patient flow. A model that achieves high accuracy on a held-out dataset but drifts silently in production, or
produces outputs no operator can interpret, is not useful.
We are looking for someone from an engineering, mathematics, or computer science background who builds analytical systems
with the same rigour they would apply to a physical design. You will work on real plant data from deployment day one. The
problems are not textbook problems: the data is noisy, the labels are delayed or absent, and the failure consequences are visible
immediately.
WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON
– Development and validation of predictive models for industrial processes: equipment health monitoring, process parameter
optimisation, throughput forecasting, and anomaly detection
– Feature engineering from plant sensor data: time-series preprocessing, rolling statistics, frequency-domain features, and
physics-informed derived variables
– Model deployment pipelines: packaging models for edge inference, building monitoring frameworks for production model
performance
– Automated reporting and visualisation: operational dashboards for plant managers, investor-facing analytics outputs, and internal
performance tracking
– Statistical analysis in support of commercial decisions: cost-benefit modelling for automation investments and PFI index
calculations
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
– Final year or recent graduate in engineering, mathematics, statistics, or computer science from a recognised institution
– Analytical-grade programming: you have built data pipelines or analytical systems beyond tutorial exercises
– Sound statistical foundations: you understand the difference between a model that fits and one that generalises, and you know
when a simpler approach is right
– Any project, thesis, or internship work involving real data and a problem with genuine uncertainty
– Ability to communicate quantitative results to non-technical stakeholders, both in writing and visual formats
– Exposure to time-series data, signal processing, or sensor data systems is a meaningful advantage
COMPENSATION & CONDITIONS
This position is offered on the Fluxion Professional pay scale. Entry level hires join at FP1 (₹16 LPA CTC) or FP2 or FP3 (up to
₹45 LPA CTC) based on performance during the selection rounds. All components of the CTC are discussed and agreed at the
offer stage. Roles involve travel to industrial sites, port terminals, and project locations across India; all travel and accommodation
are covered by Fluxion.
